title: Breach Breaker
tagline: Defend the world one turn at a time!
pitch: Players control an array of customizable units to fend off waves of enemies in a tactical grid-based battlefield. Each turn allows for strategic movements and attacks, while the pressure of incoming threats keeps the gameplay intense.
coreLoop: Players navigate a grid, positioning units to attack or defend against incoming enemies for each turn. Swift decision-making and tactical planning are key to surviving successive waves.

mechanics.name: Unit Movement
mechanics.description: Players click to move units within a limited range on the grid.

mechanics.name: Attack Mechanics
mechanics.description: Select enemies in range; each unit has a distinct attack pattern that triggers effects based on enemy type.

mechanics.name: Combo System
mechanics.description: Perform combo attacks by positioning units strategically, increasing score and dealing bonus damage.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to navigate grid, Space to confirm actions
controls.mouse: Click to select and move units

difficulty.start: easy enemy waves with predictable movement patterns
difficulty.progression: introduce varied enemy types and movement patterns
difficulty.peak: multiple powerful enemies with unique abilities in later waves

winLose.win: survive a set number of enemy waves
winLose.lose: all units are destroyed or a key structure is compromised

juice.screenShake: when units take damage or enemies are defeated
juice.hitStop: when a unit lands a critical hit
juice.flash: when the player wins a round or loses the game

scopeNotes: no complex AI systems, no multiplayer features, no in-depth story elements, no different terrains or environments, no lengthy tutorials, no intricate resource management

scoreEvents: score increases by 100 points for each enemy destroyed, 50 points for surviving a turn, combo bonuses give additional score
